bmc-headless-browser.label: Private browser login
bmc-headless-browser.description: Staged isolated login/capture adapter, not the arbitrary-code browser. Requires separate console runtime activation, supported login form and trusted HTTPS IP certificate. Save again when migrating from legacy setup; old values are not silently reused.

bmc-html5-kvm.label: Private HTML5 console login
bmc-html5-kvm.description: Staged isolated login/canvas adapter. Requires console runtime activation, trusted HTTPS IP certificate and compatible HTML5 launcher. Input needs exact-action approval; no cookie, storage or script API is exposed.

ipmi-redfish-bmc.label: Default management login
ipmi-redfish-bmc.description: Eligible for an explicitly scoped read-only Redfish connection after runtime activation. Requires a trusted HTTPS certificate with the private IPv4 address in its SAN. IPMI, SOL and server changes are not supported by this adapter.

ipmi-redfish-bmc.label: Private IPMI/SOL login
ipmi-redfish-bmc.description: Staged trusted host adapter: read-only chassis status or task-bound SOL. Requires console runtime activation, exact private IPv4 target, LAN/Full Network operations, lanplus cipher 17 and BMC SOL privileges. Opening SOL and every input require separate approval; no power-control or global SOL-deactivate operation.
